The '''Derf Chapter''', having [[Tik Tali Talosh]] as [[President/Legends|president]], was a sector of the [[Max Rebo Fan Club]], which was dedicated to the [[Max Rebo/Legends|eponymous]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]]. The Derf Chapter shared its name<ref name="SWI 67" /> with the [[Derf system/Legends|Derf system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Derf Chapter was introduced in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
